title: What if you woke up 100 years in the future?

lines.text: What if you woke up one hundred years in the future?
You fall asleep tonight, and open your eyes in twenty-one twenty-six. The bed is the same. The world outside is not.
By morning, you notice nobody drives. Cars glide through quiet lanes in the sky, and the air is clean.
By noon, your phone is a museum piece. People talk to the air, and screens appear wherever they look.
By sunset, the shock sets in. Your money is worthless, your skills are a century old, and everyone you knew is gone.
But medicine had a hundred years too. Aging is now a treatable condition. You might live to see twenty-two twenty-six.
So, what would you do first? Learn the new world, or go back to sleep?
